info.name: 11 - Attendance
info.description: Endpoints to record member check-ins and retrieve gym attendance dashboards, logs, and per-member history.

request.description:
Fetches today's attendance stats and the 10 most recent check-ins for a gym.

### Route Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `gymId` | `int` | Yes | Target gym ID |

### Response (`GymAttendanceDashboardRDTO`)

- `gymId` (`int`)
- `stats` — `todayCheckInsCount`, `currentlyInsideCount`, `activeMembersCount`, `expiredMembersCount`
- `recentEntries` — list of `{ attendanceId, memberId, memberFullName, profilePictureUrl, planType, checkInTime }`

Fails with `403` if the gym is not the current user's active gym.

### Authorization

Requires gym role `Owner`, `Manager`, `Receptionist`, or `Coach`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.

Records a check-in for a member. `gymId` is resolved from the authenticated user's active gym.

### Request Fields (`RecordCheckInCDTO`)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `memberId` | `int` | Yes | Gym person ID of an active member |

### Behavior

- Fails with `404` if the member does not exist, is not a `Member`, belongs to another gym, or is not `Active`.
- Fails with `422 MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE_OR_EXPIRED` if the membership is inactive or expired.

Returns `201 Created` with `Result<object>` containing message "Check-in recorded successfully.".

### Authorization

Requires gym role `Owner`, `Manager`, or `Receptionist`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks. Rate-limited via `UserRateLimiter`.

Fetches the full gym attendance log with dynamic sorting and filtering.

---

### Available Domain Attributes & Filter Reference

| Attribute Name | Data Type | Filter Support | Description / Allowed Values |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `Id` | `int` | Exact | Unique Identifier |
| `GymId` | `int` | Exact | Associated Gym ID |
| `MemberId` | `int` | Exact | Gym person ID of the member |
| `CheckInTime` | `DateTime` | Between | ISO check-in timestamp |
| `RecordedById` | `int?` | Exact | Gym person ID who recorded the entry |
| `EntryMethod` | `string` | Exact | e.g. `Staff Override` |

---

### Filter Usage Guide (For Request Body)

- **Exact Filters (`exactFilters`):** Pass attribute name with array of string/enum values. Example: `"exactFilters": { "MemberId": ["5"] }`
- **Between Filters (`betweenFilters`):** Pass attribute name with `min` and `max`. Example: `"betweenFilters": { "CheckInTime": { "min": "2026-01-01", "max": "2026-12-31" } }`

---

### Authorization

Requires gym role `Owner`, `Manager`, or `Receptionist`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.

Fetches the attendance log filtered to a single member.

### Request Fields (`MemberAttendanceHistoryPagedReq`)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `memberId` | `int` | Yes | Gym person ID of the member |
| `pageNumber` | `int` | No | Defaults to 1 |
| `pageSize` | `int` | No | Defaults to 10, max 50 |
| `orderBy` | `string` | No | Defaults to `Id` |
| `orderDirection` | `string` | No | `asc` or `desc` |

Returns `Result<PaginatedRes<AttendanceLogItemRDTO>>`.

### Authorization

Requires gym role `Owner`, `Manager`, `Receptionist`, `Coach`, or `Member`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.
